items.t: Report: Peltola campaign linked to effort to recruit second Dan Sullivan in Alasaka Senate race
items.x: Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in efforts to recruit a second Dan Sullivan for Alaska's Senate race, The New York Times reports. The candidate is now on the ballot alongside the GOP incumbent.
